claims.content: The System Operator reports an emergency condition requiring search and rescue efforts by transmitting a J3.1 Emergency Point message.

goal.raw_text: The System Operator reports an emergency condition requiring search and rescue efforts by transmitting a J3.1 Emergency Point message.

claims.content: System Operator
The System Operator acts on a previously reported emergency point or initiates a report for which the Joint Unit (JU) assumes reporting responsibility ($R^2$).

If the JU does not currently hold reporting responsibility ($R^2$), it may only assume it if the unit with $R^2$ is declared inactive (via J7.0 ACT=0) or if no periodic update is received for three consecutive intervals.
The initiation of the report is performed through operator action only.
The System Operator transmits a J3.1 Emergency Point message upon identifying an emergency condition requiring search and rescue efforts.

trigger.raw_text: The System Operator transmits a J3.1 Emergency Point message upon identifying an emergency condition requiring search and rescue efforts.

claims.content: The System Operator identifies an emergency condition requiring search and rescue efforts.
The System Operator transmits a J3.1 Emergency Point message to report the emergency condition.
If the emergency point is related to a previously reported track or point, the J3.1 message shall include the TN of the previously reported entity as amplifying information.
The emergency point shall be assigned a TN (Track Number) by the reporting JU, which must be different from the TN of the previously reported entity if applicable.
If reporting on a previously reported emergency point, the System Operator acts only when the JU has additional or more current information on the point.

If assuming reporting responsibility (R²) for an emergency point due to the previous reporting unit being inactive or missing updates, the System Operator uses the same TN Reference and TN Previously Reported values as the previous reporting unit.
Any Joint Unit (JU) may report, through operator action only, on a previously reported emergency point when that JU has additional or more current information on the point.

If a J7.0 (ACT = 0) message is received on an emergency point declaring the unit with reporting responsibility ($R^2$) inactive, or if no periodic update is received for three consecutive update intervals, another JU may, by operator action only, assume $R^2$ for the point.
A JU assuming $R^2$ for an emergency point shall use the same TN Reference and the same value of TN Previously Reported as those reported by the previous reporting unit.
When the Exercise Indicator is set to value 1 in the J3.1 message, the report is for exercise purposes and is not an actual emergency.
The emergency point shall have a TN Reference different from the TN Previously Reported.
If the emergency point is related to a previously reported track or point, the J3.1 message shall contain the TN Previously Reported as amplifying information.
The latest Joint Unit (JU) to report a point has reporting responsibility (R²) for that point.
